description: A sprite sheet of SIX separate props arranged in a grid of 2 columns and 3 rows (two props side by side in each row), each centered in its own wide cell, in this exact order: top row left: a small worn canvas travel tent, beige cloth stretched over wooden poles with ropes and stakes, open flap, wide and low, filling most of its cell; top row right: a lit campfire ring of grey stones with burning logs and bright orange flames; middle row left: a neat stacked pile of chopped firewood logs with an axe stuck in a stump next to it; middle row right: a small wooden treasure chest with iron bands and a brass lock, lid closed; bottom row left: three bulging tied burlap grain sacks leaning together; bottom row right: a small wooden weapon rack holding two old spears and a round wooden shield, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, muted natural colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no water, no shadow puddles, no text, no numbers, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their 3 by 3 layout.
